findings.summary: The query-key length check is redundant.
findings.consequence: This keeps an unnecessary branch in the request boundary, making the API validation slightly harder to audit without changing behavior.
findings.evidence: Object.keys(query) cannot return duplicate key names. With only one permitted key, queryKeys.some(key => key !== "media_type") already rejects every multi-key query that includes any other key, while duplicate media_type parameters arrive as one key with an array value and are rejected by the media value check on line 493.
findings.recommendation: Remove `|| queryKeys.length > 1`, or rewrite the guard as an explicit allowed-key shape check if the length is meant to document the one-key invariant.
